people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: When Abram had come into Egypt, Egyptians saw that the woman was very beautiful.
translations.bsb: So when Abram entered Egypt, the Egyptians saw that the woman was very beautiful.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, that, when Abram was come into Egypt, the Egyptians beheld the woman that she was very fair.
translations.asv: And it came to pass, that, when Abram was come into Egypt, the Egyptians beheld the woman that she was very fair.
